cpu_result_ready_ms.end: cudaEventSynchronize(end) after full forward pipeline; output resident on GPU
includes: allocation growth during frame if needed

gpu_span_ms: CUDA events around camera transfer and the complete pipeline. Can include GPU idle gaps caused by CPU planning and host synchronization; not sum of GPU busy kernel time.
scan_ms: Prefix scan + CPU instance readback/allocation interval
sort_ms: Duplicate/bucket generation, CUB sort, range identification
build_ms: Feature kernel + metadata D2H + host plan + schedule H2D/queue reset. Combined interval; separate device feature/copy durations unavailable.
render_ms: Native tile grid or bounded queue render kernel event interval
cpu_plan_ms: Host planning interval only; excludes features/readback and schedule upload
finite: 1 means per-frame finite checked. -1 in nodig sensitivity means unchecked except final frame.
hash_x_hash_sum: Two 64-bit reductions over color, final_T and n_contrib, out of timed interval. Shared mix primitive; collision probability not formally derived. Qualification uses full raw bit comparison.
memory: Model/scratch buffer sizes reported after each process; scheduler buffers add 76*tile_count+8 bytes. Peak allocator residency and external GPU use are not isolated; telemetry snapshots are inclusive GPU usage.
observer_effect: Every timed formal frame followed by untimed digest and readback; it may change next-frame cache state. Predeclared no-digest pairs use only final-frame checking.
